name: PvZ Content Mod
description: Three red plants: a Red Peashooter (175 sun, one fire pea, unlocked with the Snow Pea), a Red Repeater (225 sun, two peas per volley, unlocked with the Repeater) and a Red Gatling Pea (275 sun, four peas per volley, unlocked by buying the shop's Gatling Pea) - registered through the pvz-fabric content API and drawn with the game's own retail art recoloured red, on the lawn and on their seed packets alike. It uses api-plant to register and api-resource to place and keep the art.
